## Data checklist

- [ ] The project(s) are open source and the license is visible.
- [ ] The relationship with the game is verifiable and explained.
- [ ] `description_es` and `description_en` are present and under 300 characters.
- [ ] `repo` uses the `owner/repo` format.
- [ ] No ROMs, ISOs, original assets, piracy links or malware.
- [ ] The project is not a duplicate.
- [ ] GitHub metadata is not edited by hand.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run validate`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Checked `/es/` and `/en/`
- [ ] Checked the affected game/project pages
- [ ] Checked search and filters
